meta.name: gstack-health
meta.description: GStack health-check method for broad project or repository health review across tests, docs, DX, release readiness, and maintainability.

copy.tagline: 检查项目健康度，覆盖测试、文档、发布准备等维度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统性地评估项目或仓库的整体健康状况。
copy.tagline_en: Check project health across tests, docs, release readiness, and maintainability.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic health check for your project or repository.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析项目或仓库的健康状况，给出健康摘要、主要风险、优先改进项和下一步建议。
howto.when: 当你询问项目健康、架构现状、轻量级就绪度，或直接说“$gstack-health”时触发。

say.text: 检查一下这个项目的健康状况。
say.note: Claude 会分析当前仓库并输出健康报告。

say.text: 帮我做一次架构现状扫描。
say.note: Claude 会进行广泛的状态检查。
Claude 会给出风险和改进建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes project or repository health, producing a health summary, top risks, prioritized improvements, and recommended next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about project health, architecture current-state scan, lightweight readiness, or explicitly invoke "$gstack-health".

say_en.text: Check the health of this project.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the current repo and output a health report.
Claude will perform a broad state check.
Claude will give risks and improvements.
